description: This is a test suite written in Python using pytest to verify the correct utilization of custom tokenizers in the litellm library, specifically focusing on the handling of custom_tokenizer configurations in model_info during token counting operations. The tests check scenarios involving multilingual models, local llama models, and default behaviors for models without custom_tokenizer.

methods.name: test_custom_tokenizer_from_model_info()
methods.description: Verifies that the token_counter uses the custom tokenizer defined in model_info, specifically for multilingual embedding models, and that the tokenizer_type reflects the correct tokenizer used.

methods.name: test_custom_tokenizer_with_llamacpp()
methods.description: Tests that a local llama model with a custom_tokenizer uses the correct tokenizer instead of defaulting to OpenAI's tokenizer.

methods.name: test_multilingual_e5_embedding_model()
methods.description: Confirms that a multilingual embedding model configured with a specific tokenizer uses that tokenizer during token counting.

methods.name: test_model_without_custom_tokenizer_uses_default()
methods.description: Ensures that models without a custom_tokenizer fall back to the default OpenAI tokenizer.
